art_direction: RoomScale category: settlement_structure. Keep the roof open enough to read its machinery from strategy view. Materials should show grain, worn iron, aged copper, and restrained brass under RoomScale lighting. Render in the approved cinematic miniature-diorama style, with scale-driven stylization but tangible, carefully manufactured construction.
